name: Production reign eras at marathon speed: first three changes exactly on turns 196,217,328

steps.code:
if GameConfiguration.GetRuleSet()~='RULESET_JAC_BANSEIKI' or GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()~=1 then error('wrong ruleset/start turn') end
local speed=GameInfo.GameSpeeds[GameConfiguration.GetGameSpeedType()]
if speed.GameSpeedType~='GAMESPEED_MARATHON' or speed.CostMultiplier~=300 then error('wrong speed') end
local want={ERA_ANCIENT=65,ERA_CLASSICAL=7,ERA_MEDIEVAL=37}
local actual={}; for row in GameInfo.Eras_XP1() do actual[row.EraType]=row end
for kind,length in pairs(want) do
 local row=actual[kind]
 if not row or row.GameEraMinimumTurns~=length or row.GameEraMaximumTurns~=length then error('production length overridden '..kind) end
end
if GameInfo.Eras['ERA_JAC_SHOHO']==nil then error('48-reign era table missing') end
local count=0; for _ in GameInfo.Eras() do count=count+1 end
if count~=48 then error('expected 48 eras') end
return true

local T,n,kind=195,0,'ERA_ANCIENT'
local t=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1
if t~=T then error('turn '..t..' expected '..T) end
local index=GameInfo.Eras[kind].Index
if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()~=index then error('era mismatch on turn '..T..': '..tostring(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra())) end
local l=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
if type(l)~='table' or l.reign~=n or type(l.history)~='table' then error('ledger reign mismatch on turn '..T) end
if l.history['r'..(n+1)]~=nil then error('next reign judged early') end
return true

local T,n,kind=195,0,'ERA_ANCIENT'
local t=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1
if t~=T then error('turn '..t..' expected '..T) end
local index=GameInfo.Eras[kind].Index
if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()~=index then error('era mismatch on turn '..T..': '..tostring(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra())) end
local l=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
if type(l)~='table' or l.reign~=n or type(l.history)~='table' then error('ledger reign mismatch on turn '..T) end
if l.history['r'..(n+1)]~=nil then error('next reign judged early') end
if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEraStartTurn()~=1 then error('engine era start mismatch') end
return true

if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('official era popup shown') end
StartEraShow()
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('official era popup opened') end
return 'official era popup suppressed'

local T,n,kind=196,1,'ERA_CLASSICAL'
local t=Game.GetCurrentGameTurn()-GameConfiguration.GetStartTurn()+1
if t~=T then error('turn '..t..' expected '..T) end
local index=GameInfo.Eras[kind].Index
if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra()~=index then error('era mismatch on turn '..T..': '..tostring(Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEra())) end
local l=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
if type(l)~='table' or l.reign~=n or type(l.history)~='table' then error('ledger reign mismatch on turn '..T) end
if l.history['r'..(n+1)]~=nil then error('next reign judged early') end

local h=l.history['r'..n]
if type(h)~='table' or h.turn~=T or h.due~=T or h.length~=195 or h.from~=n-1 then error('judgement mismatch on turn '..T) end
if type(h.p0)~='table' then error('human judgement missing') end
print('[JAC_ERA_VERIFY] turn='..T..' reign='..n..' era='..kind..' ledgerEngineEra='..tostring(h.engineEra))
return true

local h=l.history['r'..n]
if type(h)~='table' or h.turn~=T or h.due~=T or h.length~=195 or h.from~=n-1 then error('judgement mismatch on turn '..T) end
if type(h.p0)~='table' then error('human judgement missing') end
print('[JAC_ERA_VERIFY] turn='..T..' reign='..n..' era='..kind..' ledgerEngineEra='..tostring(h.engineEra))
if Game.GetEras():GetCurrentEraStartTurn()~=196 then error('engine era start mismatch') end
return true

if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('official era popup shown') end
StartEraShow()
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('official era popup opened') end
return 'official era popup suppressed'

local l=Game:GetProperty('JAC_AGES_LEDGER')
local r=l and l.history and l.history['r1'] and l.history['r1'].p0
if type(r)~='table' then error('human ledger result missing') end
local last=JAC_REIGN_POPUP_LAST
if type(last)~='table' or last.reign~=1 or last.reignType~='REIGN_KOJI' or last.turn~=196 or last.age~=r.age or last.score~=r.score then error('automatic reign popup record mismatch') end
if ContextPtr:IsHidden() and not JAC_ShowReignPopup(true) then error('cannot reopen reign popup') end
if ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('reign popup hidden') end
if Controls.Title:GetText()~=Locale.ToUpper(Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_REIGN_KOJI_ANNOUNCEMENT')) then error('reign title mismatch') end
if Controls.EraRibbonValue:GetText()~=JAC_AgesView_AgeLabel(r.age) then error('age label mismatch') end
if Controls.Score:GetText()~=Locale.Lookup('LOC_JAC_AGE_REIGN_SCORE','LOC_JAC_REIGN_TENBUN_NAME',r.score) then error('score text mismatch') end
OnClose()
if not ContextPtr:IsHidden() then error('reign popup did not close') end
return true
